items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I was playing with him at the time... Bill Matthews, he was playing drums.

ctx.x: Who did they have with him?

Who did they have with him then? What he had with him? Yeah. You might know the fellas. I was playing with him at the time. Bonnie, Bonnie Pigar, yeah, him. And his brother, drum, yeah. We were playing together. Alex. Yeah. And then Charlie, Charlie Decanje, he was blowing trumpets. He's up there. Real light fella. Yeah, he's up there, but he don't play. He's a policeman up there now. Where? Where's the policeman at? I believe in Chicago. And, uh, what's the other fella named? Bill Matthews, he was playing drums.…

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: He had to tell you, man. He had Bill Matthews and George Williams.

ctx.x: Ask him what Bottler's name was.

He said, what's Bottler's name was? I forget his first name. That's his last name, Bottler. And he was playing with us with our tape, you know. And, uh, and I tell you, he got rid of him. And he got washed, you see. And then, uh, you know, until I got down there, they tried to let them band stay on the job too long, you see. So, he's a different man, you know. Like that. That's what I tell you about, about a month ago now. He had to tell you, man. He had Bill Matthews and George Williams. And two more other…
Thomas Jefferson's in on the trumpet.
